name: ForLoop
formula: =LAMBDA(start,end,func,[step],LET(step, IF(ISOMITTED(step), 1, step), output, DROP(REDUCE(0, SEQUENCE((end - start) / step + 1, 1, start, step), LAMBDA(acc,i, VSTACK(acc, func(i)))), 1), output))
comment: For loop. 'func' shall be a lambda function LAMBDA(i,output) to describe the actions to be taken in the for loop. Last Update 2025-08-01.
